meta.title: New assignee gets the new text; the old assignee's 'unassigned' message is unchanged
gaps: Reassign the PR-1 item from User A to User B.
Log in separately as User B and User A and open each user's bell notifications.
Verify User A's prior unassigned notification count is unchanged.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Reassign the PR-1 item from User A to User B.; Log in separately as User B and User A and open each user's bell notifications.; Verify User A's prior unassigned notification count is unchanged.
